# MM-P3-L4-RR01 — Maintenance manual - Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1
Revision: Rev F (supersedes Rev E)  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01

## Scope
This document provides maintenance steps specific to Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) at Plant P3, line P3-L4. It addresses clamp bolt torque and main roll bearing lubrication activities required for safe, repeatable operation. Related documents: SB-1028, SOP-P3-L4-02, SOP-P3-L4-03.

## Tools
- Calibrated torque wrench capable of applying the specified clamp bolt torque.
- Clean lint-free rags and approved bearing lubricant.
- Inspection light and mirror.
- Lockout/tagout kit per SOP-P3-L4-02.

## Procedure
1. Perform lockout/tagout as directed by SOP-P3-L4-02 and verify energy isolation.
2. Access mandrel clamp assembly following SB-1028 disassembly sequence.
3. Inspect clamping hardware for visible wear, deformation, or contamination. Clean mating surfaces with lint-free rag.
4. Install clamp bolts finger-tight to seat components. Using the calibrated torque wrench, apply the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 605 N·m. Follow tightening pattern from SB-1028 to ensure even seating.
5. Remove access panels to reach main roll bearings. Clean bearing housings and inspect for metal debris or lubricant breakdown.
6. Lubricate main roll bearings in accordance with bearing supplier recommendations and SOP-P3-L4-03. Note the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 135 hours. Record lubricant type, batch, and time-in-service in maintenance log.
7. Reassemble guards and remove lockout/tagout only after verifying no tools or debris remain.

## Acceptance criteria
- Mandrel clamp bolts remain at specified torque with no visible clamp misalignment or joint separation.
- Main roll bearings show clean lubricant appearance and smooth rotation; no abnormal noise on manual spin.
- Maintenance actions and lubricant application recorded and traceable to SB-1028, SOP-P3-L4-02, SOP-P3-L4-03.
- Machine returns to service only when all criteria above are met and authorization obtained per SOP-P3-L4-02.
